    level="1"

    pfs="Standard"
>
[Graft Technician](/Feats.aspx?ID=5542) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="General" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=615" />
<trait label="Skill" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=695" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 97

**Prerequisites**
Expert in [Medicine](/Skills.aspx?ID=42)

</column>

---

You can create and implant [grafts](/Rules.aspx?ID=3275). When you select this feat, you gain the formulas for four common grafts of 3rd level or lower. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to [Medicine](/Skills.aspx?ID=42) checks to implant grafts. If you’re a master in Medicine, this bonus increases to +2.
name: Graft Technician
